title: YEARS Algorithm pour embolie pulmonaire (PE)
formula:
Refer to decision tree:

![](https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/cdn-web-img.mdcalc.com/YEARS_Algo_PE_2025.png)

- It's imperative to know if your institution reports D-dimer in FEU or DDU. This tool displays cutoffs for D-dimer reported as FEU.
- An approximate conversion that is often referenced is FEU = DDU * 2.

Adapted from[Van der Pol 2019](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1813865).

Take note of the following exclusion criteria:

- Treatment with therapeutic doses of anticoagulants initiated 24 hours or more before eligibility assessment.
- Life expectancy less than 3 months.
- Geographic inaccessibility precluding follow-up.
- Pregnancy (be sure to use pregnancy-adapted YEARS algorithm in the calc).
- Allergy to intravenous contrast agent.

how_to_use.why:
- Reduces unnecessary imaging, radiation exposure, and contrast risk through a simplified algorithm that includes key predictive criteria without losing diagnostic safety.
- The index study demonstrated an absolute 14% decrease in the use of CT pulmonary angiogram (CTPA) when using standard thresholds and an absolute reduction of 8.7% when using an age-adjusted D-dimer threshold.
- Has been evaluated and validated for use in the pregnant patient population.
how_to_use.when:
- Use in hemodynamically stable patients ≥18 years old with clinically suspected PE.
- It has also been adapted for use in the pregnant patient population.
- Exclusion criteria include:

 - Treatment with anticoagulation initiated 24 hours or more prior to assessment.
 - Life expectancy <3 months.
 - Allergy to intravenous contrast agent.
 - Geographic inaccessibility for follow-up.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Uses three items from the original [Wells’ Criteria for PE](nabda:calc.wells-criteria-pulmonary-embolism) that were most predictive for PE: Clinical signs of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), hemoptysis, and if PE is the most likely clinical diagnosis.
- Applies a variable D-dimer threshold based on whether zero, one, or more clinical criteria are present
- PE as the most likely clinical diagnosis is a criterion that is clinician-dependent and can meaningfully affect the D-dimer threshold.
- Adapted to include the pregnant patient population.
- Identify your institution’s D-dimer assay units; this tool uses fibrinogen equivalent units (FEU) reported as ng/mL FEU.

next_steps.advice:
- Use this clinical decision tool as an adjunct to clinical judgment and evaluation in the appropriate patient for whom you are considering PE as a diagnosis.
- If the YEARS algorithm rules out PE, no further workup for PE is recommended.
- If the YEARS algorithm is unable to exclude PE, proceed with CTPA (or V/Q scan in patients where CTPA is contraindicated, such as those with iodinated contrast allergy, significant renal insufficiency, or in pregnant patients where minimizing radiation exposure to the fetus is preferred).
- If there are clinical signs of DVT in the pregnant population, obtain compression ultrasonography of the indicated leg first.
next_steps.critical_actions:
- **NE PAS** utiliser cet outil chez les patients hémodynamiquement instables.
- Tenir compte du risque hémorragique avant d'initier une anticoagulation chez les patients chez qui une thromboembolie veineuse (TEV) a été mise en évidence.
- S'assurer que le seuil de D-dimères approprié est utilisé, en fonction à la fois du nombre de critères positifs et des unités utilisées par votre établissement.
- Faire preuve de jugement clinique lors de l'utilisation de l'outil et de l'interprétation de ses résultats.
next_steps.management:
- Si une EP est confirmée par angio-TDM thoracique, initier une anticoagulation après évaluation du risque du patient.
- Si une EP est exclue par l'algorithme YEARS, poursuivre votre évaluation clinique et le bilan d'autres diagnostics selon les indications.
